newsitem.title: THAILAND: Reference rate firms to 32.094-Bank of Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Reference rate firms to 32.094-Bank of Thailand.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Monday said the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 32.094 per dollar against 32.236 on Friday.
The reference rate is the average rate traded the previous day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed flotation of the baht.
The baht was quoted at 32.10/32.40 to the dollar onshore and 32.00/32.20 in offshore markets early.
